desc:
Buy your favorite car and drive it on the wide streets of Riyadh. Don't forget to become a policeman to conduct inspections or a criminal to flee, or a player and a player to play the same real life scenario 🚗 


The development and update of this map has been stopped.


This map warning is not similar to Riyadh in its plans or streets! Just the design.

Collect riyals until you can buy a car 🚙
Receive the car key and hit the streets 🏆 
More than 100 cars you can buy and collect! 

You can play the game on mobile phones, computers, iPads, VR devices, and Xbox consoles 📱💻 
If you have any problems, don't forget to let us know in the map group and we will definitely get in touch with you 📞🚨

Drive Your Car Into The Streets And Be A Cop To Get The Bad Guys or just be a player and play it like a real life 🚗

There are benefits and a badge for premium users 🎖

This game is still in beta. You may find some glitches and bugs.
